players.product: High-purity sputtering targets, evaporation materials and PVD consumables (backing plates, crucible liners) for leading-edge logic, memory (incl. HBM) and data storage

quarterly_data.signal: Materion's 10-K: the backlog of unshipped orders was $579.0 million at December 31, 2025, versus $537.6 million at December 31, 2024 and $573.4 million at December 31, 2023 (generally purchase orders that may be terminated under certain conditions); Materion expects substantially all of the December 31, 2025 backlog to be filled over the next 18 months. Remaining performance obligations (contracts longer than one year) were approximately $21.9 million at December 31, 2025 versus $39.3 million a year earlier.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $579.0 million (12/31/2025) vs $537.6 million (12/31/2024); RPO ~$21.9 million
